The model combines convolution-like operations with logical inference: local regions are matched in a spatially distributed manner, while the match- ing results are represented, combined, and revised using NAL. All intermediate representations are expressed in logical form, making each processing step inter- pretable and allowing recognition outcomes to be traced back to their contribut- ing components and spatial structure.

In this work, we constructed a na¨ ıve visual recognition model based on Non- Axiomatic Logic (NAL), in which the process from pixels to higher-level inter- pretation is formulated as a series of logical inference steps. The main contribu- tion of the paper is not a direct comparison with highly optimized recognition systems, but a concrete demonstration that visual recognition can be expressed within a logical framework. In the proposed model, objects are represented as compositional concepts, lo cal observations provide evidential support to candi- date hypotheses, and recognition emerges from the accumulation and revision of such evidence. The resulting system maintains explicit intermediate repre- sentations, so the learned prototypes and their matches remain interpretable throughout the hierarchy.

The current model has several additional limitations. Spatial sense is assumed to be given in advance, though in principle it should itself be learnable [ 11 ]. question.text: 视觉识别能否被构造成逻辑推理？本文以 NAL 为基础，通过 CCN 展示像素到对象解释的可行路径。

concepts.text: 对象由部件及相对位置构成；局部观察对对象假设提供分级证据，经累积和修正更新判断。

formal_model.text: 原型保留部件、位置和真值；匹配积累局部证据支持整体假设，学习用支持识别的局部证据修正原型结构。

assumptions.text: 空间结构预先给定，编码简化为黑／白二值；模型被动扫描，尚不自主决定注意、信息获取和行动。

recognition_learning.text: CCN 交替运行前向匹配与学习：局部输入匹配原型库，产生概念实例；胜出原型由局部证据修正。高层将低层概念组合为更大结构。

evaluation.text: MNIST：第一层用 10,000 张图像训练，第二层与线性 SVM 用 20,000 张。训练第二层时冻结第一层，训练 SVM 时冻结两层，SVM 不参与原型学习；在完整测试集评估。

findings.text: 训练准确率 99.3%，测试准确率 95.5%。低层形成边缘等局部原型，高层组合笔画片段。作者重视可解释分层概念的获得，SVM 只是表征质量的辅助指标。

limitations.text: 验证仅覆盖 MNIST，缺少消融、鲁棒性测试和系统比较；空间感、编码和原型相似性有简化，尚无主动注意及感知行动闭环。

open_questions.text: 后续包括空间泛化、概念相似性引导的原型泛化、更广泛评估和 3D 点云感知，并需解决如何主动组织经验、选择注意与行动。

conclusion.text: 作者认为，把视觉识别实现为 NAL 推理在最小 CCN 原型中具有可行性；该探索初步产生可解释的中层视觉概念，但尚不足以证明全面性能优势或通用视觉能力。
